info.title: AdSense Host API

requests.description: List hosted accounts associated with this AdSense account by ad client id.
requests.name: GET /accounts
requests.note: Replace {{ADSENSE_HOST_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Get information about the selected associated AdSense account.
requests.name: GET /accounts/{accountId}
requests.note: Replace {{ADSENSE_HOST_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: List all hosted ad clients in the specified hosted account.
requests.name: GET /accounts/{accountId}/adclients
requests.note: Replace {{ADSENSE_HOST_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get information about one of the ad clients in the specified publisher's AdSense account.
requests.name: GET /accounts/{accountId}/adclients/{adClientId}
requests.note: Replace {{ADSENSE_HOST_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: List all ad units in the specified publisher's AdSense account.
requests.name: GET /accounts/{accountId}/adclients/{adClientId}/adunits
requests.note: Replace {{ADSENSE_HOST_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Update the supplied ad unit in the specified publisher AdSense account. This method supports patch semantics.
requests.name: PATCH /accounts/{accountId}/adclients/{adClientId}/adunits
requests.note: Replace {{ADSENSE_HOST_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Insert the supplied ad unit into the specified publisher AdSense account.
requests.name: POST /accounts/{accountId}/adclients/{adClientId}/adunits
requests.note: Replace {{ADSENSE_HOST_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Update the supplied ad unit in the specified publisher AdSense account.
requests.name: PUT /accounts/{accountId}/adclients/{adClientId}/adunits
requests.note: Replace {{ADSENSE_HOST_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Delete the specified ad unit from the specified publisher AdSense account.
requests.name: DELETE /accounts/{accountId}/adclients/{adClientId}/adunits/{adUnitId}
requests.note: Replace {{ADSENSE_HOST_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get the specified host ad unit in this AdSense account.
requests.name: GET /accounts/{accountId}/adclients/{adClientId}/adunits/{adUnitId}
requests.note: Replace {{ADSENSE_HOST_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get ad code for the specified ad unit, attaching the specified host custom channels.
requests.name: GET /accounts/{accountId}/adclients/{adClientId}/adunits/{adUnitId}/adcode
requests.note: Replace {{ADSENSE_HOST_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
